conclusion: Existing locked-suite CLI primitives can produce a real-repository cold prepare report and separate mutation/full 15-table comparisons. entries.available: Copies locked admitted source into a fresh temporary project; prepare calls public index full=true. prepare.json retains elapsed_us and original IndexReport result; manifest.json records engine/source/input/config. resources.jsonl and query outputs are separate observations.
entries.limits: Suite timeout_ms is validated in 1..600000 and applies to each MCP operation. Performance profile separately requires Release eval, warmup, >=200 query samples; smoke is not stable performance certification. This path does not mutate A/B or compare full parity.

entries.available: Materializes two disposable identical admitted input copies; keeps A across steps; each step applies the same mutation to A/B, invokes original A incremental and B full, compares all 15 canonical tables and optional public search probes. oracle.json records incremental_report/full_report and checkpoint-*-incremental/full.json retain every canonical row.
gaps: Initial CodeIndexBackend::new invokes build_index_report(false) on an empty index and discards its returned cold report. It does not retain initial full parity.
Each mutation invokes one incremental build. There is no explicit resolution_freshness.complete gate or resume loop in oracle::run; equal alone cannot be promoted to complete closure.
Uses the legacy in-memory canonical row cap: checks rows.len()>100000 before push; it is not the scalable double-spool oracle.
Both temporary project directories are deleted at return; they cannot subsequently be passed to p8-oracle. Suite timeout_ms is metadata-validated but not wrapped around this in-process oracle call.

entries.available: Reads existing persisted indexes only, full 15-table double-spool comparison; writes binary_digest, paths, tables, comparison/error, elapsed_ns and actual exit_code 0 equal / 1 unequal / 2 error. No repair/build performed.
entries.limits: Default 5,000,000 rows/table; aggregate canonical bytes 4 GiB; scratch 8 GiB; max row 1 MiB. CLI does not expose a repository build, mutation, deadline, resume loop or budget override.
